s: As part of Green initiative, Indian Navy installed solar power panels on board on?
x: INS Sarvekshak, a hydrographic survey ship, was the first Indian Navy ship to install a solar power system (Green Initiative, February 2017), with 18 flexible 300 W panels.

s: What was the total crew strength (officers, petty officers, sailors) aboard the French aircraft carrier Charles De Gaulle during the Indo-French naval exercise ' Varuna-2004 ' in April 2004?
x: 1,950 The nuclear-powered French carrier Charles De Gaulle, one of the largest warships to participate in the Indo- French Varuna exercises, carried a crew complement of about 1,950 personnel.
